scope: recommendations for every unresolved question; selecting an option still requires SYS-21 revision, impact review and regenerated evidence

recommendations.recommendation: Keep contracts within each group as peers; record conflicts and apply the more restrictive requirement.
Propose governance/compatibility-register.json as canonical, with a generated Markdown view and CI; the current recovery map is reference evidence, not that approved register.

Approve a demo applicability matrix covering Identity/session/tenant/capability, isolation, database/transactions/audit, content/learning and API/web. Release proof remains required for any shared deployment.
Use backend execution-principal records plus explicit capability assignments; no product actor is registered merely because a CI job exists.
Keep deterministic paths first and runtime agents disabled; select a use case only through a dedicated C02 revision.
Inventory and approve each legacy job/worker/CLI separately, with capability, scope, transaction/reconciliation and audit ownership.

Argon2id minimum m=19456 KiB, t=2, p=1, unique random salts and versioned encoded hashes; benchmark the approved backend before implementation. V1 bcrypt is reference only, with its explicit 72-byte guard.
Revoke every session for the Identity atomically with successful credential change and audit; require a new sign-in. This is a proposed owner choice, not current authority.
Use existing verified provider-subject links; matching email alone cannot link or create a duplicate Identity. Linking to an existing Identity requires explicit user initiation and reauthentication.
Keep PIN authentication unavailable until owner supplies length, attempt limit, lock duration and reset authority; recover V1 tests before selecting values.
Use indistinguishable accepted responses for known/unknown email, with bounded abuse controls and no existence disclosure.
Propose SameSite=Lax to support provider redirects, with the separately approved Origin/CSRF control; Secure and HttpOnly remain mandatory.

Propose a same-origin web/API boundary with a host-only cookie and Path=/; exact hosts/proxy topology must be selected in Transport/hosting authority first. Do not silently reuse V1 .t34ch.com-wide trust.
Require a canonical allowed Origin for unsafe cookie-authenticated requests, including logout. Missing, foreign, malformed or null origins deny before writes.
Issue a fresh credential at successful sign-in and privilege elevation; never upgrade a pre-authentication credential. Implement rotation/revocation atomically.
Propose no count limit initially; preserve expiry/revocation controls. A later limit needs explicit selection and deterministic eviction semantics.
Choose normalized multi-organization, multi-location membership rather than V1 single-location compatibility. Exact Membership/Location/grant shapes still require promotion and admission.
Require explicit organization/location scope in the typed request, validated against current membership; reject zero, multiple or ambiguous selections. Transport encoding follows separate authority.
Keep platform cross-tenant access absent initially. Global Identity lifecycle authority in a multi-tenant model needs a separately reviewed scope/actor policy.

Recover V1 ordered current-fact evaluation and deny tests; amend its vocabulary/bundles for V2. A full capability/command/bundle matrix must be proposed and owner-approved before this question can be resolved. A direction alone is insufficient.
Approve no cross-tenant platform grants initially; do not import V1 platform_operator grants or role aliases.
Propose offboarding as access revocation with retained history; require exact owner-approved meanings and field actions for deletion, anonymization and retention before implementing erasure.
Owner must supply periods per Identity/Credential/session/token/membership/learning/certification/audit class and legal-hold handling. No unsupported universal duration is proposed.
Owner must name each deletion-exempt class, retained fields and legal/audit basis. No blanket audit exemption is inferred.
Propose machine-readable JSON plus a readable summary; owner must supply fulfillment deadline and identity/scope verification requirements.
Owner must supply a deletion deadline, verification standard and exception/hold response policy.
Propose a verified, scoped and audited operator procedure initially, before self-service export/deletion UI.
Propose no browser-reachable application tables. If hosted-auth roles exist, prove every application table remains backend-only; no implicit RLS exemption.
Propose a manual exact-candidate owner-approved production apply after existing backup/restore/recovery gates. Development CI cannot grant production permission.
Keep legacy data import absent; a later import needs its own source snapshot, transformation, reconciliation, audit and rollback plan. Code lessons are not data migration.
Propose email and OAuth first; select actual providers and per-effect reconciliation adapters explicitly. Payments stay disabled.
Propose a fixed central record-class policy initially without tenant overrides; owner must supply exact duration and privacy/legal-hold treatment. Audit deletion stays blocked meanwhile.
Propose reconstructable lifecycle history for Identity, Membership, Assignment and Certification, with derived projections kept separate from canonical state.
Propose scoped records for capability/tenant/target violations and invalid/revoked credential abuse, with rate limits and redaction; avoid turning every validation typo into permanent audit.

Propose strict SemVer 2.0 for schema and pack versions, immutable published content and exact version/digest references. Do not copy V1 version helper leading-zero acceptance. Physical ContentVersion binding remains a separate shape gate.
Propose version/digest-bound approvals in Content-owned records, written only by an authorized customer approver; record actor/scope/time and required audit.
Recover only named legacy formats with fixtures, version validation, deterministic conversion and removal conditions; no permissive catch-all parser.
Keep XP/mastery/streak/rank unavailable until exact versioned derivation formulas and replay evidence are owner-approved; persisted completion does not imply scoring.
Existing sessions/history stay pinned to their assigned content version; new assignments use an explicitly selected new version without rewriting past evidence.
Propose direct reports intersected with current organization/location scope; reporting relationships narrow visibility and never create capabilities.
Propose manager offboarding only with its dedicated capability and canonical Identity service; global/multi-tenant effects need explicit policy before grants.
Propose private, authenticated and scoped certification verification initially. A public link feature requires a separate approved disclosure model.
Propose version/digest-bound criteria approvals in Certification-owned records, with designated authorized customer approvers and audit.
Propose structured checklist results and scoped observation notes first; photo uploads require separate storage/privacy/retention decisions.
Propose learner and observer must be distinct Identities for the same certification.
Propose no automatic expiry initially; if expiry is desired, owner must approve its representation, effects and history/revocation rules.

Prepare an exact exception list for health/readiness and necessary sign-in/provider-callback routes; all product operations use the approved versioned boundary. No routes are authorized by this proposal.
Propose a uniform code/message/requestId envelope and identical non-disclosing target denials; publish the exact schema before handlers/client code.
Propose /api/v1 for core operations and an explicit major-version/deprecation manifest with owner-selected sunset periods.
Propose WCAG 2.2 AA with keyboard/focus, screen-reader, contrast, touch-target and low-end-device evidence; automation supplements manual checks.
Confirm the complete path list: login, assigned-content start, recorded completion, scoped manager view and logout; credentialless demo isolation/reset remains separately specified.
Propose independent verification for C11-C15, C21-C23 and C51-C52 plus protected cross-domain mutations; self-audit is never the independent reviewer.
Propose repo metadata plus SHA-bound CI artifacts; owner must choose artifact duration and durable archival. Current GitHub artifacts are not assumed permanent.

Propose PROVEN only with current verified evidence, BLOCKED for unmet gates, UNKNOWN for insufficient/stale evidence, CONTRADICTORY for conflicting facts; declared/inferred never auto-promote to PROVEN.
Propose Vercel web/API with managed PostgreSQL using V1 experience; exact account/projects/environment/cookie topology still need explicit approval and validation.

Propose exact deployment/config/schema identity, health/readiness, role/scope denials, assigned-content start/completion, atomic audit and logout replay plus recovery checks. URL 200 alone is insufficient.
Owner must choose the rollback observation window and data/migration compatibility requirements; no duration is inferred from V1 runbooks.
Owner must select error/alert providers and verified alert destinations; recover V1 redaction/correlation tests independently of provider choice.
Propose no credential or learner payload content in logs; permit only approved correlation and pseudonymous operational identifiers with scope-aware access.
Owner must choose log retention and redacted archival policy separately from canonical audit retention.
Keep analytics disabled initially; provider/enablement is a later dedicated decision.
Keep identifying learner fields absent; approve a minimum schema before enabling analytics.
Keep offline writes unauthorized. V1 queued completion is useful historical evidence, but cannot establish V2 durable completion or offline permission.
Keep self-service billing disabled initially.
Do not select a payment provider or permit money movement in the foundation batch.
Propose Organization-owned local billing-account relationship and read-only entitlement projection; exact cardinality/provider linkage requires owner-approved semantics.
